strapiBlog.title: 8 Most Expensive Branded Residences in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai has become the global epicenter of luxury branded residences, where renowned fashion houses, automobile brands, and luxury hospitality chains bring their signature touch to ultra-exclusive homes.

data.text:
Dubai has become the global epicenter of luxury branded residences, where renowned fashion houses, automobile brands, and luxury hospitality chains bring their signature touch to ultra-exclusive homes. These properties offer a seamless blend of design, prestige, and top-tier amenities, commanding multi-million-dollar price tags.

If you're looking to invest in top branded real estate in Dubai, here are eight of the most expensive branded residences, featuring opulent layouts, world-class amenities, and unparalleled exclusivity.

List of Branded Residences in Dubai

In the golden city, branded residences have redefined the meaning of opulence, offering exclusivity, exceptional craftsmanship, and curated amenities that set them apart from traditional luxury properties.

But ‘what are branded residences?’ They are a unique segment of luxury real estate, combining the prestige of world-renowned brands with high-end property developments. These homes are designed to offer an elevated living experience, featuring meticulously crafted interiors, cutting-edge architecture, and services that rival five-star hotels.

These projects not only guarantee unparalleled quality but also provide investors with strong capital appreciation due to their association with globally celebrated names. Whether you seek a sleek urban penthouse or a serene beachfront villa, Dubai branded projects present some of the most sought-after addresses in the world.

ORLA Dorchester Collection

Developed by Omniyat in collaboration with Dorchester Collection, ORLA Dorchester represents an epitome of luxury. The 2 to 4-bedroom sky palaces and penthouses are designed with panoramic ocean views, vast open-plan layouts, and refined interior finishes. 

Exclusive access to a private infinity pool, an elite beach club, and Michelin-starred dining adds to its prestige, making it a top-tier branded luxury property in Dubai.

  • Starting Price: USD 1.22M (AED 4.5M)
  • Location: Palm Jumeirah

Armani Beach Residences

Crafted by Giorgio Armani in partnership with Arada Properties, Armani Beach Residences reflect the brand’s signature elegance and refined aesthetics. The 2 to 5-bedroom apartments and penthouses feature minimalist yet opulent designs, complemented by private beach access, a high-end wellness club, and round-the-clock concierge services. 

This development is a prime example of why branded residences attract the world’s elite.

  • Starting Price: USD 6.26M (AED 3.75M)
  • Location: Palm Jumeirah

Bugatti Residences

Bringing automotive excellence to real estate, Bugatti Residences by Binghatti offers 2 to 4-bedroom sky mansions with sleek, race-inspired interiors. Each residence includes a hyper-luxury car lift, allowing owners to showcase their vehicles within their homes. 

A Riviera-inspired beach, private pools, and an exclusive Bugatti lounge ensure that residents experience the pinnacle of automotive-infused luxury living.

  • Starting Price: USD 5.19M (AED 3.7M)
  • Location: Business Bay

Atlantis The Royal Residences

Developed by Kerzner International, Atlantis The Royal Residences offer 2 to 5-bedroom sky villas and penthouses that blend architectural brilliance with resort-style indulgence. 

Featuring a 90-meter infinity pool, private beach access, and dining by celebrity chefs, this property is one of the best luxury properties in Dubai for those who demand a seamless fusion of extravagance and lifestyle.

  • Starting Price: USD 816k (AED 3M)
  • Location: The Palm

Karl Lagerfeld Villas

These meticulously designed villas are a tribute to the legendary fashion designer Karl Lagerfeld. Developed by Taraf Holdings, each villa boasts Karl Lagerfeld-inspired interiors, private pools, and expansive landscaped gardens. 

As part of the growing list of branded residences in Dubai, Karl Lagerfeld Villas cater to fashion-forward investors looking for exclusivity in one of Dubai’s most prestigious districts.

  • Starting Price: USD 5.94 (AED 2.18M)
  • Location: Meydan

The Ritz-Carlton Residences

Synonymous with five-star hospitality, The Ritz-Carlton Residences at Dubai Creekside feature 2 to 5-bedroom residences and penthouses. Developed by Khamas Group, these residences include open-plan layouts, a residents-only wellness club, a private marina, and personalized concierge services. 

A true reflection of Dubai branded projects, this development offers a blend of tranquility and opulence in one of the city’s prime waterfront locations.

  • Starting Price: USD 2.99M (AED 1.09M)
  • Location: Dubai Creekside

Mercedes-Benz Places

A partnership between Binghatti and Mercedes-Benz, this development combines high-performance design with intelligent living. The 1 to 4-bedroom residences feature German-engineered interiors, advanced smart home automation, and a luxury auto gallery. 

Mercedes-Benz Places is a unique addition to the Dubai branded projects landscape, appealing to investors who seek innovation-driven real estate.

  • Starting Price: USD 2.99M (AED 1.09M)
  • Location: Downtown Dubai

Six Residences The Palm

A sustainability-driven project by Select Group, Six Senses Residences The Palm integrates natural materials with modern architecture. The 2 to 5-bedroom residences and penthouses include a holistic wellness spa, saltwater pools, bio-hacked fitness facilities, and a private beach. 

This development exemplifies the growing appeal of branded luxury properties that prioritize well-being without compromising elegance.

  • Starting Price: USD 2.56M (AED 940k)
  • Location: Palm Jumeirah

faqs.question: Are branded residences in Dubai a good investment?

data.answer: Yes, branded luxury properties in Dubai are highly sought after for their exclusivity, strong resale value, and high rental yields, making them an attractive investment for both local and international buyers.

faqs.question: What is the difference between branded residences and regular luxury properties?

data.answer: Branded residences are developed in collaboration with global luxury brands, offering signature designs, elite services, and unique lifestyle perks that differentiate them from standard high-end properties.

faqs.question: Which areas in Dubai have the most branded residences?

data.answer: Some of the top locations for Dubai branded projects include Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai Creekside, where some of the most prestigious developments are located.
